message: 初仕事

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, I'm gonna give it everything I've got today!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, should you really be yelling like that?」

name: Synn
message: 「We aren't open yet, so nobody's here anyway.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Is that really how this works...?」
For today, I'm serving as the acting librarian.
It's my very first job, officially entrusted to me by Melilot.

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, it's almost time to open...」
My job today is to supervise the library and make sure no trouble breaks out.
On holidays, it's open to the general public as well, and dorm students also come by to study on their own.
Even if I can't handle things as well as Melilot does, there's still plenty for me to do.

name: Paqy
message: 「Well then, I think I'll treat myself to a nice little nap.」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't talk in your sleep, okay?」
I have Paqy sit at the reception desk.

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「Oh, Prez」

name: Synn
message: 「Morning, Tennouji-san」

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「Sorry for making you cover for Melilot-san」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't worry about it. I'm doing it because I want to.」

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「Huh, impressive. It's a hassle for me, so it really helps.」

name: Synn
message: 「Glad to hear it」

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「Well, I'll be over there organizing the library cards.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. I'll be doing the rounds.」
Well, Melilot-san already organized the bookshelves before leaving, so there isn't really much to check on.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey there, Shio-chan」

name: Shio
message: 「Eek!?」

name: Shio
message: 「O-Oh, if it isn't Synn-dono... What a coincidence.」

name: Synn
message: 「Rare to see you in the library. Looking for a martial arts book or something?」

name: Shio
message: 「Ah, no, well, how should I put it...」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, or are you studying on your own? Somehow, studying in the library just feels more productive, doesn't it?」

name: Shio
message: 「Haha... y-yes, quite so...」

name: Misa
message: 「Shio...」

name: Shio
message: 「Hyaaah!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Found you」

name: Shio
message: 「I-I've been found out...」

name: Synn
message: 「What's up, are you studying on your own too, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「He said he was worried about the next test, so I was helping Shio with his studies」

name: Misa
message: 「And yet, he went and slipped away right in the middle of it」

name: Shio
message: 「B-But I couldn't possibly trouble you any further, Elder Sister...」

name: Misa
message: 「If you really feel that way, then just behave and study」

name: Shio
message: 「Y-Yes... I am terribly sorry...」

name: Synn
message: 「It'll be fine. If you study here, I think you'll be more efficient, too」

name: Shio
message: 「D-Do you really think so...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, just trust me and give it a try」
Even just getting into that mindset makes a world of difference.

name: Misa
message: 「...I hear you're acting as Miss Melilot's proxy, Sakura-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmm... well, don't push yourself too hard」

name: Synn
message: 「I won't」

name: Misa
message: 「...Hmph」

name: Misa
message: 「Come along, Shio」

name: Shio
message: 「Understood. Well then, Lord Synn, please excuse me」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, Synn-kun spotted♪」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Good day to you, President. How are things faring?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, hello. Doing so-so, I suppose」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Why, that is splendid to hear」

name: Ria
message: 「Let me know if you run into any trouble. I'll help you out」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much」

name: Synn
message: 「By the way, are you two looking for some books?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. For our Wagashi Club activities」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Might you know whereabouts the books on making wagashi are kept?」

name: Synn
message: 「If that's what you need, they're all gathered in that section over there」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Is that so. You have been a tremendous help, President」

name: Synn
message: 「Not at all」
It's all thanks to Melilot-san teaching me how the books are arranged.

name: Ria
message: 「Well then, keep up the good work」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, there he is! That's the President!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Ooh, fidget, fidget...」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte... Please keep quiet inside the library」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oops, how careless of me」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I suppose even monkeys get distracted, as they say」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that girl a friend of yours? I don't recognize her face...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, right! Let me introduce her」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This is my childhood friend and bestie, Amyrina」

name: Amyrina
message: 「H-H-Hello, my name is Amyrina...」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm the Student Council President, Synn Sakura. Well, I'm just filling in as librarian today, though--nice to meet you」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Y-Yes! Pleased to meet you」

name: Synn
message: 「Exploring the library today?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Since Amyrina isn't used to things here yet, I've been showing her around town」

name: Synn
message: 「I see」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now then, Amyrina, let's head to the next spot!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Aah, please wait for me, Lolotte~」

name: Synn
message: 「No running either~」
...What did they even come here for.

name: Synn
message: 「Hello. Didn't know you read too, Azel」

name: Azel
message: 「...You're noisy」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Oh, you were looking for a quiet place, huh」

name: Azel
message: 「That's right」

name: Azel
message: 「However, my expectations were misplaced」

name: Synn
message: 「Why? I think it's pretty quiet here, though」

name: Azel
message: 「You're here」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, sorry. I'll go over there, so...」

name: Azel
message: 「...You're noisy」

name: Synn
message: 「Aah, he left...」
I wonder how Melilot-san would handle a situation like this.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, hard at work, I see」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ah, it's Synn-kun. Yahoo~」

name: Synn
message: 「Somehow, I'm running into everyone a lot today」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh? What are you talking about?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nothing, just talking to myself」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You're amazing, Synn-kun. Being able to do librarian work too~」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, it's questionable whether this even counts as doing a good job」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I couldn't do it. Cooped up in a place like this all day long, I mean.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Me too~. Looking at nothing but books makes me sleepy~」

name: Synn
message: 「You think so?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aren't you bored?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, I'm actually pretty fine with it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, really. Well, I'm truly envious」
Bored, huh.
Come to think of it, that's true.
Up until now, Melilot-san had been handling the librarian duties all by herself, every single day.
I wonder how that must have felt......

name: Synn
message: 「There aren't any problems in particular, and it's so peaceful......」
I guess there's nothing to be done about the snoring.

name: Melphas
message: 「Pardon the intrusion」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, if I recall, you're Melphas-san」

name: Melphas
message: 「I am honored that you remember me, my lord President」

name: Synn
message: 「Not at all」

name: Melphas
message: 「However, thank you very much for introducing me to Lady Reiko the other day」

name: Melphas
message: 「Thanks to you, I was able to indulge in a sweet conversation with a wonderful madame」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, no...... I'm glad if you enjoyed yourself......」

name: Melphas
message: 「My only regret is wishing we could have met thirty years sooner......」
He's even more formidable than I thought.

name: Melphas
message: 「By the way, I would like to inquire......」

name: Melphas
message: 「I have heard that in this library, a most lovely librarian loses herself in thought while admiring the books」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, do you mean Melilot-san?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Lady Melilot... Truly, a name both clever and lovely...」

name: Melphas
message: 「Where is she right now?」

name: Synn
message: 「She's off today, though」

name: Melphas
message: 「Oh, what a shock...!」

name: Melphas
message: 「She is not here today... How could this be...」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, are you okay...?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Ah, yes, please pay it no mind」

name: Melphas
message: 「Regrettably, it seems today was simply not an auspicious day」

name: Melphas
message: 「I shall call again at a later date, so for the time being, please give these to Lady Melilot」
I receive a magnificent bouquet of roses.

name: Melphas
message: 「Farewell」

name: Synn
message: 「...Better put them in a vase」
I wonder if there's a vase around...?

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, that should do it」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, Synn-chan, aren't those lovely roses」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, Helena-san」

name: Helena
message: 「Being acting librarian seems to be going smoothly」

name: Riesling
message: 「Thank you for your hard work, Synn-sama. Please have some cheddar cheese chocolate as a refreshment」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-thanks... Even you, Riesling-san, what brings you here?」

name: Riesling
message: 「I was granted a day off by my lady today」

name: Riesling
message: 「In exchange, I am currently keeping an eye on Helena」

name: Helena
message: 「Geez, you make it sound like I'll cause trouble if left alone」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha...」

name: Helena
message: 「So, are you having any trouble with anything?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. For now, I think things are going fine.」

name: Helena
message: 「I see. That's wonderful to hear.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Knowing Melilot, I'm sure her advance briefing was thoroughly prepared.」

name: Riesling
message: 「And given that you were the one receiving it, Lord Synn, worrying unnecessarily would be quite tactless.」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That's giving me too much credit...」
The two of them really trust Melilot, huh.

name: Synn
message: 「Um, by the way, you two and Melilot are really close, aren't you?」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes. Everyone--ourselves included--agrees we're best friends.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Though whether Melilot would admit it honestly is questionable.」

name: Helena
message: 「Ah, the memory of exchanging cups beneath the peach tree feels so nostalgic...」

name: Riesling
message: 「Just which banquet are you remembering, I wonder?」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be that you're all graduates of our school...?」

name: Helena
message: 「I am, though the other two aren't.」

name: Helena
message: 「Melilot and I go way back, from even before I enrolled at the academy...」

name: Helena
message: 「I first met Tamiko when Melilot and I were studying abroad at an overseas university.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, studying abroad!」

name: Riesling
message: 「That time remains a fond memory even now.」

name: Helena
message: 「Indeed it does.」

name: Synn
message: 「That sounds really nice, having a history like that...」
For Helena and the others, it must be a wonderful chapter of their youth.

name: Riesling
message: 「Before or since, that was the first time I ever failed a mission. It was a good learning experience.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Mission?」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, trying to abduct and confine someone like me was a million years too early for you.」
That wonderful image of youth was suddenly shrouded in dark clouds.

name: Synn
message: 「Um, what are you talking about...?」

name: Helena
message: 「Back in the day, Tamiko-chan was a top-notch hitman sent by the organization to take me out」
I find myself nodding involuntarily.

name: Helena
message: 「Before we knew it, though, a friendship had blossomed between us as we communicated with our fists」

name: Riesling
message: 「How nostalgic......」

name: Helena
message: 「Reenactment VTR! Tamiko-chan's sniper rifle roars!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Prepare yourself......!」

name: Helena
message: 「Samurai Gun!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Such kinetic vision......!」

name: Helena
message: 「Projectiles are so uncouth, don't you think? Let's settle this fair and square with our fists!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Very well. I shall finish you in a single blow!」

name: Helena
message: 「Too slow! Chickenwing Facelock!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Impossible!」

name: Helena
message: 「Submissions are the true techniques of a champion!」
What happened to fists......?

name: Riesling
message: 「I-I yield......」

name: Helena
message: 「Phew, that was a pretty good match」

name: Riesling
message: 「Hmph, likewise」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu. Come on, a handshake of friendship」
They sure get along well......

name: Riesling
message: 「Ever since then, I have been deeply indebted to Helena and Melilot」

name: Helena
message: 「Setting Tamiko-chan up as the Rosenkreuz family's butler was actually kind of fun♪」

name: Riesling
message: 「As a measure to secure backing after leaving the organization, it was the best possible choice」

name: Riesling
message: 「Thanks to that, I was also able to cross paths with Milady......」

name: Helena
message: 「And ever since we came back here, Melilot has become a fine librarian, too」

name: Riesling
message: 「That was an incident that truly symbolized our relationship」

name: Synn
message: 「Sounds like... you've both been through a lot...」
After that, they continued sharing dramatic stories from their past that felt very true to Helena-san and the others.
Maybe I've gotten acquainted with some pretty amazing people.

name: Helena
message: 「Phew」

name: Helena
message: 「My, we ended up getting completely carried away talking, didn't we」

name: Riesling
message: 「Could it be nearly closing time?」

name: Helena
message: 「Sorry about that, Synn-chan. Seems like we got in your way」

name: Synn
message: 「No, not at all, the pleasure was mine」

name: Synn
message: 「I got to hear stories I don't normally get to hear, so it was fun」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my. Synn-chan, could it be you're dying to know the secrets of a mature woman?」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-What are you saying!」

name: Riesling
message: 「This humble servant does not possess any personal information worth keeping secret, however」

name: Helena
message: 「Whoa♪ Laying it all bare, are we\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek! Please stop it already!」

name: Melilot
message: 「What are you all making such a commotion about...」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, if it isn't Melilot」

name: Riesling
message: 「Welcome back」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Good grief」

name: Melilot
message: 「Teaming up to tease Sakura-kun like that is quite immature of you both」

name: Helena
message: 「What's that for, stingy!」

name: Helena
message: 「Just because your favorite Synn-chan got stolen away doesn't mean you have to get all worked up」

name: Melilot
message: 「Wh-Wh-Who, whose favorite are you talking about!?」

name: Riesling
message: 「My apologies. It is nearly time for me to go pick up the young lady」

name: Helena
message: 「Right, I still have work left to do too\s07」

name: Melilot
message: 「Ah, hey, wait!」

name: Helena
message: 「See yaa~. Bye-bye-boon!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Good grief, those two...」
When the three of them are together, Melilot-san makes that kind of face too....
I feel like I've gained a little something again.

name: Synn
message: 「Um, Melilot-san...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Ah, excuse me」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun, thank you for your hard work today. I imagine it was quite rough in many ways, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「No, it was fulfilling」

name: Synn
message: 「I even got to see things I wouldn't normally get to see」

name: Melilot
message: 「Well, if you say so, Sakura-kun, then I suppose it's fine」

name: Melilot
message: 「Now then, I have business at the archive storage from here」

name: Synn
message: 「That book... are you going to carry it?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes」

name: Melilot
message: 「Borrowing this was my errand for today」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll help you」

name: Melilot
message: 「No, that's quite alright. You must be tired too, Sakura-kun...」

name: Synn
message: 「...Is it because of the rules?」

name: Melilot
message: 「It helps that you're quick on the uptake」

name: Synn
message: 「...Understood」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, I'll leave the rest to you」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. Truly, thank you for your hard work today」

name: Melilot
message: 「From what I can see, it seems you handled the job admirably...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Thanks to you, Sakura-kun, you were a tremendous help」

name: Synn
message: 「That's only because you're such a good teacher, Miss Melilot」

name: Melilot
message: 「Heehee...」

name: Melilot
message: 「You're quite skilled yourself, Sakura」

name: Synn
message: 「A-ahaha...」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, excuse me!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. Goodbye」
My heart leaps at the thought that I've earned another bit of Miss Melilot's trust.
When did I start feeling like this?

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, come to think of it...」
I heard all sorts of stories about the past from Miss Helena and the others, yet...
When it comes to Miss Melilot, the one I want to know about the most, I still don't know a single thing...
